component.name: AWCC Linux
component.summary: Thermal, fan curve, and RGB lighting control for Alienware systems

description.p: AWCC Linux (awcc-rs) is a Rust and Slint Material 3 desktop application and command-line interface for controlling thermal profiles, G-Mode (GameShift), manual fan boost, custom temperature-to-boost fan curves, CPU TCC offset, and Alienware ELC USB HID RGB lighting on supported Alienware and Dell G-Series systems.
Includes a deterministic hardware simulation mode (--sim) for offline verification, UI inspection, and headless screenshot rendering without requiring physical hardware access.
